hypothesis: Instruction count combines per-frame overhead, distinct spatial costs for first and subsequent frames, and quadratic spatial attention work.

pcvs.name: latent_frames
pcvs.rationale: Tracks decoder invocations and per-frame cache-management overhead.

pcvs.name: first_frame_area
pcvs.rationale: Tracks spatial work for the first frame, which skips cached temporal upsampling.

pcvs.name: subsequent_frame_area
pcvs.rationale: Tracks convolution, normalization, copying, and upsampling work for subsequent frames.

pcvs.name: attention_work
pcvs.rationale: Tracks the quadratic spatial component of decoder attention.
